verdict.rationale: Firecrawl documents crawling an entire website and recursively fetching every page, with webhook notifications as a crawl progresses, so the deep-crawl core of the story is covered. Nothing in the pack mentions a breadth-first traversal strategy or a configurable maximum page limit, which are the story's specific requirements. Missing for 10: documented breadth-first strategy, configurable max-page limit parameter, independent or hands-on corroboration of crawl behavior at scale.
